question: Does a reranker over the top 50 memories find more relevant memories in the final 10 than the current scorer?
decision: Whether to propose a reranker stage for memory retrieval on all hosts, or test BM25 next.
approval: Operator asked on 2026-10-17 for one simple experiment in its own worktree. Chose reranker first, AI labels with operator spot check, 60 prompts, Standard. Running needs separate approval.

H1.statement: Mean recall@10 of Arm B minus Arm A >= 0.05, and two-sided sign test over prompts with differing recall gives p < 0.05.

hypotheses.H0: Gain < 0.05, or p >= 0.05, or Arm B worse.

decision_rule.pass: H1, guardrail P and guardrail L hold: write an OpenSpec proposal for a reranker stage, with a human-labelled confirmation run.
decision_rule.fail: Keep the current scorer; plan Experiment 25 (BM25 over memory content).
decision_rule.unclear: Gain >= 0.05 with p >= 0.05, or G3 or G5 fails: INCONCLUSIVE; operator decides on a larger run.

stats.test: two-sided sign test on prompts where recall@10 differs (Experiment 18 run_eval.py sign_test)
stats.intervals: mean difference with win, loss and tie counts; no shared bootstrap helper exists
stats.exploratory: Arm A0 (top 10, no cut-off) against A and B; recall per arm on prompts with any relevant memory

gates.G1_integrity: snapshot files and reranker GGUF SHA-256 match before and after
gates.G2_embedding_match: 5 random stored memories re-embedded via 127.0.0.1:9931 have cosine >= 0.999 with stored vectors
gates.G3_coverage: at least 40 of 60 prompts have one or more relevant memories in the pool
gates.G4_completeness: every prompt has A, A0 and B lists; every pool pair judged; errors count as misses
gates.G5_key_check: operator agrees with the AI judge on at least 16 of 20 spot-check pairs
gates.guardrail_P: Arm B precision >= Arm A precision - 0.10
gates.guardrail_L: reranker delay p95 <= 500 ms per prompt

arms.A: exact scan of eligible memories; score 0.6*content_sim + 0.4*max(tags_sim, word_match_boost); keep score >= 0.6; top 10
arms.B: top 50 by the Arm A score with no cut-off; rerank prompt against memory content (cut at 4000 characters); top 10 by reranker score
arms.A0: exploratory: top 10 by the Arm A score with no cut-off

data.memories: ~/.omms/data/projects/project_769e931b738f5620_shard_0.db, read-only copy; SHA-256 recorded at prepare
data.prompts: ~/.omms/data/user-prompts.db omms rows, read-only copy; SHA-256 recorded at prepare
data.sample: 60 prompts, seed 24, at most 2 per session
data.prompt_filter: omms project path; length >= 40; not a slash command; no <private>; distinct text
data.eligible_memories: created before the prompt and not from the prompt's session
data.pool: union of A0 top 10 and B top 10, shuffled, arm and rank hidden
data.relevant: the memory would help an assistant answer or act on the prompt

fixed.judge: Claude subagent, blind to arm and rank; model id recorded in output
